intent.zh: 修复能力中心盘点中的 P0/P1 阻断项：已通过版本删除会永久销毁归档（F-01）、空壳 App 无释放路径（F-02）、normalize 绕过发布内核（F-03）、展示版本两口径（F-04）、直发/审批权限反转（F-05）；同时修 org 多版本多卡（F-06）、下架冻结 check-then-act（F-14）与撤回前端的删除/预览入口。
intent.en: Fix the capability-center blocking P0/P1s: approved-release deletion destroying archives (F-01), no release path for empty App shells (F-02), normalize bypassing the publish kernel (F-03), two display-version authorities (F-04), direct-publish/approval permission inversion (F-05); also dedupe multi-version org cards (F-06), atomically enforce delist freeze (F-14), and hide delete/preview entries that would destroy or 404.
